title: Page heading of the Settings console (/settings). Noun, 1 word.
navLabel: aria-label of the Settings sub-navigation rail. Screen-reader only, names the region.
appearance.title: Panel heading above the theme picker. Noun, 1 word.
appearance.themeLabel: aria-label of the theme radiogroup. Screen-reader only, 1 word.
appearance.theme.system: Theme option: follow the operating system. Fits a narrow radio tile, ≤1 word.
appearance.theme.light: Theme option: always the light theme. Fits a narrow radio tile, ≤1 word.
appearance.theme.dark: Theme option: always the dark theme. Fits a narrow radio tile, ≤1 word.
appearance.systemHintDark: Hint under the theme picker when 'System' is selected AND the OS currently resolves to dark. One full sentence. Do not interpolate the theme name — write the sentence out, so adjectives can agree.
appearance.systemHintLight: Same as appearance.systemHintDark, but the OS currently resolves to light.
appearance.fixedHintDark: Hint under the theme picker when the user pinned the dark theme, overriding the OS. Mentions that it applies to this device only. One full sentence.
appearance.fixedHintLight: Same as appearance.fixedHintDark, but the light theme is pinned.
language.title: Panel heading above the language picker. Noun, 1 word.
language.groupLabel: aria-label of the language radiogroup. Screen-reader only, ≤2 words.
language.hint: Hint under the language picker. Two short sentences: the choice is stored ON THE ACCOUNT so every device the operator signs in on follows it (it used to be device-only, before users.locale existed), and data the user enters is never translated. This is a promise about scope, so be precise, not chatty.
password.title: Panel heading of the change-password form. Noun phrase.
password.current: Field label: the password the user has right now.
password.new: Field label: the password they want instead.
password.confirm: Field label: retype the new password.
password.hint: Hint under the new-password field stating the minimum length (8 characters). One short sentence.
password.submit: Submit button of the change-password form. Imperative, ≤3 words.
password.success: Confirmation shown next to the button after a successful change. ≤3 words, past tense. A ✓ glyph is rendered separately in markup — do not include it.
password.errors.currentRequired: Field error: the current-password field was left empty. Says what to do.
password.errors.tooShort: Field error: the new password is under 8 characters. Says what to do.
password.errors.mismatch: Field error: the two new-password fields differ.
password.errors.failed: Banner error when the API rejects the change for an unknown reason. No trailing period (it sits alone in an error box).
account.title: Panel heading above the user's own email address, read-only. Noun, 1 word.
